About Daycare Map

A free tool to help Saskatchewan families find regulated child care and keep track of who they've contacted.

Colour theme

Where the information comes from

Listings are compiled from publicly available sources — the Government of Saskatchewan's regulated child care registry and Saskatchewan 211 (parentcentral.sk.211.ca). This app reproduces that information to make it easier to search and organize; it does not create or independently verify it.

Please verify before relying on it

Details such as availability, hours, fees, licensing status, and phone numbers change frequently and may be out of date, incomplete, or inaccurate here. Before making any decision, please confirm directly with the child care provider or the official government and 211 sources. Distances and travel times shown are estimates only.

No affiliation or endorsement

This is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Government of Saskatchewan, Saskatchewan 211, or any provider listed. All provider names and marks remain the property of their respective owners.

Provided "as is"

This app is offered for general assistance and informational purposes only, without warranties of any kind, express or implied. It does not constitute professional, legal, medical, or child care advice.
